annotation.title_clean: PAS 1882:2021 Data collection and management for automated vehicle trials for the purpose of incident investigation. Specification
annotation.title_en: PAS 1882:2021 Data collection and management for automated vehicle trials for the purpose of incident investigation. Specification
annotation.authors_or_issuer: BSI (British Standards Institution), sponsored by CCAV
annotation.summary_en: BSI PAS 1882:2021, sponsored by CCAV, specifies requirements for collecting, curating, storing and sharing data during UK automated vehicle trials to support incident investigation. It builds on PAS 1881:2020 and aims to improve trial safety and aid criminal, civil and safety investigations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies collection, curation, storage and sharing of information in automated vehicle trials
Covers automated and co-operative driving trials on land with public access in the UK
Data essential to the automated driving system's operation, plus other data held by the trialling organization
Recommends additional data a trialling organization should collect
First standard with a system-based approach to incident investigation for automated vehicles
